summary.zh: 南部关键早期遗址；伊拉克古迹局 1946–1949 年发掘，Safar、Mustafa 与 Lloyd 1981 年正式报告公布欧贝德相关深地层序等。
summary.en: Key southern early site; Iraqi excavations 1946–1949 published in Safar, Mustafa & Lloyd 1981, documenting the deep Ubaid-related sequence and later levels.
